title: 第30章 首战锁灵阵
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
子时刚过，林尘用唐玉的令牌打开了万毒窟的玄铁门。

    门后面是一条深不见底的甬道，空气里裹着一股辛辣的苦涩味。

    他点燃引路香，暗红色的烟雾像一根细线般往深处飘去。

    走了大约一炷香，甬道两侧开始出现岔路。

    他在第一个岔路口拨开石壁上的苔藓——一枚逆时针螺旋的毒纹刻在石壁上。

    唐铮的暗记。

    沿着暗记继续深入，每隔数十丈就有一枚，形成了一条完整的路线。

    走到第四个岔路口时，引路香的烟雾忽然变浓，直直地往左侧岔路深处飘去。

    林尘正要跟上去，灵纹感知忽然捕捉到一股不属于念毒的灵力波动。

    活的妖兽，速度极快。

    一头体型堪比猎犬的毒蝎从黑暗中窜出，浑身甲壳呈暗紫色，尾钩高高翘起，钩尖上渗着墨绿色的毒液。

    它的背上布满了密密麻麻的念毒结晶，体内的念毒已经和灵力系统完全融合。

    毒蝎没有给他思考的时间。

    尾钩闪电般朝他面门刺来，林尘侧身避开，钩尖擦着耳廓划过。

    毒蝎一击不中，尾钩立刻回甩，从侧面横扫他的腰腹。

    他脚尖点地往后飘了数尺，尾钩在石壁上划出一道深深的沟痕。

    系统弹出一道提示。

    “检测到念毒改造体，金丹初期。弱点：甲壳接缝处灵力密度最低，锁灵阵可将接缝暴露时间延长至五息。念毒毒丸对改造体有双倍杀伤效果。”

    林尘把最后一枚念毒毒丸捏在指尖。
content_en:
Just after midnight, Lin Chen used Tang Yu's token to open the black iron gate of Ten Thousand Poison Cave.

    Behind the door is a bottomless corridor, and the air is filled with a spicy and bitter smell.

    He lit the incense, and the dark red smoke drifted deep like a thin line.

    After walking for about a stick of incense, branch roads began to appear on both sides of the corridor.

    He pushed aside the moss on the stone wall at the first fork in the road - a counterclockwise spiral poison pattern was carved on the stone wall.

    Tang Zheng's secret message.

    Continuing deeper along the secret mark, there will be one every tens of feet, forming a complete route.

    When we reached the fourth fork in the road, the smoke from the incense smoke suddenly thickened and drifted straight into the left fork.

    Just as Lin Chen was about to follow him, his spiritual pattern perception suddenly caught a wave of spiritual power that was not thought poison.

    A living monster, extremely fast.

    A poisonous scorpion that was as big as a hound sprang out of the darkness. Its carapace was dark purple, its tail hook was raised high, and dark green venom oozed from the tip of the hook.

    Its back is covered with dense mind poison crystals, and the mind poison in the body has been completely integrated with the spiritual power system.

    The poisonous scorpion didn't give him time to think.

    The tail hook stabbed toward his face like lightning. Lin Chen turned sideways to avoid it, the tip of the hook brushing against his ear.

    The poisonous scorpion missed a hit and immediately swung its tail hook back, sweeping across his waist and abdomen from the side.

    He tiptoed back a few feet, and his tail hook carved a deep groove on the stone wall.

    The system pops up a prompt.

    "The modified body of Niandu has been detected, in the early stage of the golden elixir. Weakness: The density of spiritual power is the lowest at the seams of the carapace. The spirit locking array can extend the exposure time of the seams to five breaths. The poison pill of Niandu has double the killing effect on the modified body."

    Lin Chen held the last Niandu poison pill on his fingertips.
title_en: Chapter 30 The first battle of the Soul Locking Formation
